newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG'S COBOS TO JOIN ESPANYOL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG'S COBOS TO JOIN ESPANYOL.

text.p: Paris St Germain defender Jose Cobos will join Espanyol of Barcelona for 10 million francs ($2 million) next month when the French league season goes into winter recess.
The 28-year-old Cobos, who is of Spanish origin, will complete the move with a medical in Barcelona on December 8 and could make his debut away to Tenerife on December 22.
Cobos will link up with another Frenchman at Espanyol, France international striker Nicolas Ouedec, who was signed by the Spanish first division club in the off-season.
In his three years at PSG since joining them from his home town club Strasbourg in 1993, Cobos has helped them win the French league title in 1994 and the European Cup Winners' Cup last season.
Guingamp's French international left back Vincent Candela is PSG's most likely target as a replacement for Cobos.
Espanyol have also reportedly made a 24 million franc ($4.8 million) bid for Marseille's French international midfielder Reynald Pedros.
